Class AbstractClientView

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.client.view.AbstractClientView
All Implemented Interfaces:
ClientView
Direct Known Subclasses:
GuiView, TuiView
public abstract class AbstractClientView extends Object implements ClientView
Default no-op implementation of ClientView.

Every method is overridden with an empty body (except onError(String), which prints to System.err). Concrete view implementations (TUI, GUI) extend this class and override only the callbacks they need, avoiding boilerplate in each subclass.
